Summary: Timeout cleanup guesses the newest system-wide POWERPNT PID and can terminate an unrelated interactive PowerPoint process.
Runtime_Impact: A conversion timeout can kill a user's open PowerPoint instance.
User_Impact: Unsaved presentation work can be lost.
Tests: No PID-ownership or timeout integration test.
Recommended_Direction: Never kill a guessed PID; establish verifiable child identity/start-time/session ownership or prefer an orphan over uncertain termination.

Summary: Valid ambient commands reset barge-in processing to idle while the command is still executing, reopening overlapping capture.
Runtime_Impact: Two capture/transcribe/intent cycles can interleave and later commands can cancel speech or actions from the first.
User_Impact: Commands may execute incorrectly or Jack speech may be cut off.
Recommended_Direction: Separate narration cancellation from capture cancellation, or preserve processing until the outer command completes; add a race regression test.

Summary: Ambient arming ignores whether recorder startup succeeded and advances to armed on timers alone.
Runtime_Impact: Denied or missing microphone can leave the orchestration phase armed without a functioning recorder.
User_Impact: Practice and Ask can indicate listening without showing localMicError; commands never arrive.
Recommended_Direction: Return/observe startup success, cancel arm timers on failure, and surface the same recorder error in every mic-enabled mode.

Summary: PPTX concurrency is gated only after Express has fully buffered each upload.
Runtime_Impact: Many concurrent uploads can allocate roughly 100 MB each before receiving 429.
User_Impact: Gateway memory exhaustion or process termination.
Tests: No pre-parser admission or concurrency memory test.
Recommended_Direction: Enforce admission before body buffering through a streaming/proxy/server-level limiter and abort excess uploads early.

Summary: ASR admission is unbounded: Whisper spawns a CLI per request and VibeVoice accepts an unbounded serialized queue.
Runtime_Impact: Bursts can exhaust CPU/RAM or create an arbitrarily long stale backlog.
Recommended_Direction: Add bounded per-provider queues/semaphores, fast 429/503 rejection, and request-disconnect cancellation.

Summary: Queued VibeVoice work can respawn the warm child after gateway shutdown begins.
Runtime_Impact: Gateway shutdown can wait on or orphan a newly spawned ~1.58 GB model process.
User_Impact: Slow shutdown and lingering resource consumption.
Recommended_Direction: Add idempotent closing state; reject current/queued work and prohibit respawn after stop.

Summary: Chat validates message content but not roles or generation-control fields before forwarding the full body.
Runtime_Impact: Malformed or pathological requests can tie up inference or produce provider-specific failures.
Recommended_Direction: Validate role enum and server-owned bounds for model, token count, temperature, and grammar.

Summary: README and package configuration advertise deleted ChatGPT auth/D1/database files and retain unused Drizzle commands/dependencies.
Runtime_Impact: Documented commands fail or point nowhere; dead dependencies remain installed.
User_Impact: Setup and maintenance confusion; unnecessary supply-chain surface.
Recommended_Direction: Rewrite README for Jack, remove dead db command/dependencies, or restore the documented feature intentionally.

Summary: User-facing setup and residual contracts still describe live OpenAI voice after the Realtime path was deleted.
Runtime_Impact: No OpenAI connection exists to satisfy the guidance.
User_Impact: Users are directed toward a nonexistent capability and obsolete configuration.
Callee: none; local mic pipeline is actual authority
Recommended_Direction: Replace copy/contracts with local-pipeline terminology and remove obsolete OpenAI environment entries.

Summary: The client still exposes JSON path transcription although the gateway now rejects that mode.
Runtime_Impact: Any future caller receives 400 despite a typed/documented client method.
Tests: Gateway tests assert JSON path rejection; no client contract test.
Recommended_Direction: Remove the dead method and stale type/docs, or create a separate trusted internal interface if genuinely required.

Summary: Ask mode captures its assistant name once and never updates controller text after persona changes.
Runtime_Impact: Controller prompts/errors can retain the former persona.
User_Impact: Mixed assistant names in one session.
Tests: Scope tests do not change persona after mount.
Recommended_Direction: Use a current name ref or re-register/rebuild the controller on persona changes.

Summary: The baseline says threads use CLI default and omits -t, contradicting its own earlier text and implementation.
Runtime_Impact: No runtime defect; baseline reproduction instructions are inconsistent.
Tests: Whisper argument tests cover implementation, not document consistency.
Recommended_Direction: Update the fixed-args section to include -t 4 and remove the default claim.

Summary: Gateway suite omits chat, speech, PPTX, health, provider timeouts, CORS, and Vibe lifecycle/resource boundaries.
Runtime_Impact: Safety and lifecycle regressions can pass the prescribed suite.
User_Impact: Failures can reach local runtime unnoticed.
Tests: Service test runner was also BLOCKED_BY_ENVIRONMENT before discovery.
Recommended_Direction: Add route and lifecycle integration suites, including concurrency, shutdown, timeout, and CORS cases.

Summary: The prescribed lint command requires Bash and cannot execute on this native Windows environment.
Runtime_Impact: Local lint gate is unavailable on the audited host.
User_Impact: Windows contributors cannot run the documented lint command.
Recommended_Direction: Add a cross-platform lint entry point or explicit supported-shell bootstrap.
